description: Povodia vodárenských tokov is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.geocloud.gov.sk. The territory of the river basins of watercourses within the built-up area of the municipalities Name of the analysis/publication in which the stratum was used: Prioritisation of investment projects in the Ministry of Environment of the Slovak Republic. Coverage: SK. The portal shows the English title as "Watercourse basins" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Povodia. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
